name: Surfing Dog Inbox
subtitle: Answer bookings on your phone
promotionalText: New requests reach your iPhone as they arrive. Accept a booking, propose another time or decline it, in a tap. Your inbox stays on your own website.
description: Surfing Dog Inbox brings your business's inbox to your iPhone. Booking requests, orders, quote requests and messages that need you arrive as notifications, and you answer them from your pocket.
• See what needs you, everything, and what is already handled, for each inbox.
• Accept a booking, propose another time, or decline it.
• See today's bookings, and the orders to prepare, at a glance.
• When the time asked for is free in your calendar, the notification offers Accept: the app opens on the request for you to confirm it.
• Choose which requests you hear about, and set quiet hours that hold notifications until morning.
• Look after several businesses: connect each inbox once.
On a computer, open your inbox's Settings → Phone and press Add a phone. Scan the code with the app, then press Confirm on the computer when both show the same two digits. Nothing to type.
• Notifications are encrypted by your inbox for this iPhone alone. The relay that carries them cannot read them.
• By default a notification says what kind of request it is, when, and for what, never a customer's name or words. Turn on Show details to see them.
• Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode opens the app, and comes before an Accept from a notification. An iPhone without a passcode cannot connect.
• What the app keeps on the iPhone is encrypted with a key that never leaves this iPhone.
• The app sends us nothing about how you use it.
Without a connection the app shows the last state it saw, and says from when. What you do offline is sent when your inbox can be reached again.
You need a Surfing Dog Inbox, hosted or on your own server. Your inbox stays on your own website: the app connects to it directly. The app is open source.
